newsitem.title: USA: Prudential nonproprietary funds now under one unit.
newsitem.headline: Prudential nonproprietary funds now under one unit.

text.p: Prudential Investments, a unit of Prudential Insurance Co of America said Thursday it will now manage all nonproprietary mutual funds and annuities formerly run by its Prudential Securities Inc subsidiary.
The move continues Prudential's strategy of consolidating all money management functions within one entity, the company said.

The consolidation will help improve its sales efforts, simplify day-to-day dealings in the industry and centralize due diligence and compliance review process, said Brian Storms, president of Prudential Investments Mutual Funds and Annuities.
